answer_leakage: no canonical answer word component or one-word source alias in either system+question; actual future X/Y not known or used
categories: eight distinct factual-predicate question categories; new paired interrogative templates, one-hop data from frozen public TwoHopFact snapshot, no E110 outputs used
generation_order: frozen seeded pair order, independent of asynchronous completion order; public records interleaved member0/member1
parser: Match ready Cselection.parse exactly: ASCII punctuation deleted everywhere, first nonempty raw line, lower(), strip exterior whitespace. No Unicode-punctuation deletion, alias/prefix/whitespace normalization, first-word trimming or fallback line.
sampling: source-only one-word/no-answer-word/shortness/conflict QA; dedup by predicate+entity; seed20261030 round-robin capped by available pools, then seeded pair-order shuffle; no behaviour/reader/probe score selection
shortness: each question<=24 words; complete rendered prompt<=160 Qwen tokens, no truncation
single_word: source canonical answer is one orthographic word of Unicode letters, possibly internal hyphen/apostrophe; NOT a single-Qwen-token restriction
status: PROVISIONAL routine conventions under standing order, before any E140 output
truth: source expected answers retainedCPU for QA/provenance only, never a screen correctness gate; screening uses only actual parsed per-paraphrase outputs
